name: Right Brigade
label: Revelation
lede: Ex-Fastbreak and Follow Through kids from Boston played SSD-style hardcore, sold a thousand demos at home, and got a Revelation bio claiming they were the biggest band in hardcore.

eras.title: A thousand demos in Boston
eras.text: Right Brigade grew out of Boston's late-'90s straight edge scene, made up of former members of Fastbreak and Follow Through. They went back past youth crew to the Boston of SSD and Negative FX.

years.h: Fastbreak's former singer Patrick Rorick picks up guitar
years.p: In Right Brigade, Patrick Rorick, once [[Fastbreak|6ca65199-3330-4cb6-8589-f57930d60c28]]'s singer, plays guitar and writes much of the music, according to Lollipop Magazine; Brian "Clevo" Ristau is on Revelation's roster page.

years.h: Right Brigade's demo sells over 1,000 copies in Boston
years.p: Right Brigade, featuring former members of Fastbreak and Follow Through, self-release a demo that sells more than 1,000 copies locally, according to Last.fm's bio.

eras.title: Rev 101
eras.text: Revelation put out Right Brigade's only album as catalog number 101, fourteen songs of powerchords and mosh parts with a closing title borrowed from Hemingway.

years.p: Fourteen songs, from Broken to Isn't It Pretty To Think So?, the last line of The Sun Also Rises. The first pressing is 317 red and 775 black.

years.h: Revelation's joke bio: hardcore's biggest band
years.p: Revelation's band page for Right Brigade is a straight-faced joke. It calls Brian "Clevo" Ristau the maestro of the mosh part and says the band split when producers of "Moon Landing" questioned the song No Way.
years.xp: In the same page's interview, Ristau, asked about his edge at thirty, answers in four words. Asked where he'd be without hardcore, the answer is shorter.

years.h: Lollipop: a tougher version of early Fastbreak
years.p: Reviewing Right Brigade, Lollipop's Tim Den calls it heavy-handed hardcore, old school in all but name, and names guitarist Patrick Rorick, Fastbreak's former singer, as the likely main songwriter.
years.xp: Den liked that the band took aim at the scene's casual crowd in one song, but warned that newcomers might not tell Right Brigade from a hundred other hardcore bands.

eras.title: On the Bridge 9 singles comp
eras.text: Right Brigade's recordings turned up again on a Boston label's collection.

years.h: Right Brigade on Bridge 9 Singles Collection, Vol. 2
years.p: Right Brigade appear on Boston label Bridge 9 Records' Singles Collection, Vol. 2.
